title: Proxmox
description: Proxmox VE hosts, guests and storages from the built-in metric server (InfluxDB line protocol -> VictoriaMetrics).

panels.title: Hosts reporting
panels.description: Hosts that pushed metrics in the last 2 minutes.

panels.title: Hosts silent
panels.description: Seen in the last 7 days but quiet for 2+ minutes. dkghar-server (i9) is WOL-only, so it is often expected here.

targets.expr: count(100 * system_used{object="storages", nodename=~"$node"} / system_total{object="storages", nodename=~"$node"} > 85) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPU used (all hosts)
panels.description: Busy cores / total cores across the selected hosts.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(cpustat_cpu{object="nodes", host=~"$node"} * cpustat_cpus{object="nodes", host=~"$node"}) / sum(cpustat_cpus{object="nodes", host=~"$node"})

panels.title: Guest RAM allocated vs host RAM
panels.description: Max memory of running guests / physical RAM. Over 100% = overcommitted.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(system_maxmem{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename=~"$node"} and system_uptime{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename=~"$node"} > 0) / sum(memory_memtotal{object="nodes", host=~"$node"})

panels.title: Root disk used (worst host)
panels.description: Highest root filesystem usage among the selected hosts.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: prop = peladn, pve = evox2, dkghar-server = i9 (WOL). A silent host keeps only its Last seen value.

panels.title: IO wait by host
panels.description: Share of CPU time waiting on disk IO.

panels.title: Load per core (5m)
panels.description: Above 1 means more runnable work than cores.

panels.title: Network by host (physical NICs)
panels.description: Receive above zero, transmit below. Bridges, taps and veths excluded.

panels.title: Guests
panels.description: CPU % is of the guest's own vCPUs. Disk % only for LXCs: Proxmox can't see inside VMs without the guest agent. VM IDs repeat across hosts, so read Node + ID together.

panels.title: Top 10 guests: CPU (cores)
panels.description: Cores in use; the 10 guests with the highest peak in the range.

panels.title: Top 10 guests: CPU pressure (some)
panels.description: PSI: share of time at least one task waited for CPU.

panels.title: Top 10 guests: IO pressure (some)
panels.description: PSI: share of time at least one task waited for IO.

panels.title: Storages
panels.description: PBS datastores show once per node that mounts them (same disk).
